A benefit period begins the day you’re admitted as an inpatient in a hospital or SNF.
The benefit period ends when you haven’t received any inpatient hospital care (or skilled care in a SNF) for 60 days in a row.
If you go into a hospital or SNF after one benefit period has ended, a new one begins.
You must pay the inpatient hospital deductible for each benefit period.
There’s no limit to the number of benefit periods you can have.
